name: Baldwin Park City Council Special Meeting
minutes_text:
CITY OF BALDWIN PARK

  NOTICE OF STUDY SESSION
  CANCELLATION
  OF THE FOLLOWING:
  6:00 PM STUDY SESSION OF THE CITY COUNCIL
 NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN THAT the STUDY SESSION scheduled
 for AUGUST 3, 2016, at 6:00 PM as noted above, are hereby
  CANCELLED due to lack of business.

I, Alejandra Avila, City Clerk of the City of Baldwin Park hereby certify that, under penalty of
perjury under the laws of the State of California, the foregoing Notice of Cancellation was
posted on the City Hall bulletin board and three additional locations. Dated this 3rd day of
August, 2016.

  Alejandra Avila
  City Clerk
